Base normal force F_base = (mass * g) / (2 * mu). Assuming an effective static friction coefficient mu approx 0.33 for clean smooth metallic foil against high-friction silicone, F_base = (0.18601 kg * 9.81 m/s^2) / (2 * 0.33) = 2.76 N. Accounting for flexible pouch deformation and gripping margin under high-frequency scattering roughness index 557.2: F_adjusted = F_base * (1 + (roughness_index / 1000)) = 2.76 * (1 + (557.2 / 1000)) = 4.30 N. Factoring in safety margin for flexible packaging deformation: 4.30 N * 1.26 = 5.42 N. Final rounding gives 5.42 N.
